_: The daily stories' pictures (STORY1, spec 22 Oct 2026, sections 1.2-1.5), drawn by gen-adventure.mjs. Each story: a cast lineup first (Echo for scale beside that day's new characters), then s01-s08 and e01-e04 as tall pages, then Home's card. `light` is the story's light line (a scene's own `light` wins); `bible` names every character as NAME: so a page can be told who is NOT in it; `buddy` is the empty spot left for the child's own buddy, laid over the picture later (never painted in). `also` attaches an earlier picture of the same place (story/part), so Echo's cottage and the helper map look the same on every day.
echo: ECHO: the hero, a small round clay bird shaped like a ball, sky blue, with a pale-blue belly patch, two small teal wings, a short orange beak, two orange feet, big round glossy eyes and pink cheeks, and two head feathers on top (one coral pink, one yellow), exactly like the attached Echo picture. Echo is small: as tall as a grown-up walrus's knee.

light.day: warm, rich, sunny colors (bright blue sky, fresh greens, clear water) with gentle even daylight (no harsh golden glare, no sparkles)
light.night: a soft, cozy blue-violet evening lit warmly by lamps; never dark or scary: a deep blue-violet sea and sky, soft lilac cotton-candy fog, one round cream moon, and warm butter-yellow lamplight as the brightest thing, every face clearly and warmly lit (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.afternoon: a warm, soft late afternoon: a pale peach-and-butter sky, long gentle shadows, every color warm and clear (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.sunset: a soft peach-and-lilac sunset, warm and gentle, every face clearly lit (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.indoor: a warm honey-colored morning light pouring in through a big round window, cozy and bright (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.evening: a cozy lamp-lit evening indoors, warm and soft, every face clearly lit (no harsh glare, no sparkles)

places.cottage: ECHO'S COTTAGE: a small round clay cottage with cream walls, a round sky-blue front door, round windows with soft yellow frames, a domed straw-colored thatched roof, a little wooden porch with two wide steps, and a low white picket fence along a garden path with flowers.
places.map: THE HELPER MAP: a big hand-drawn paper map of a little island pinned to the wall, in soft crayon colors: a red-and-white lighthouse on a rocky point, a little toy shop in a town, a stone bridge over a river to a round island of pink blossom trees, and the other places hidden under soft white puffy clouds. No writing, no labels, no numbers anywhere on it.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. WALLY: Captain Wally the walrus, a big, round, chubby grey-brown clay walrus (a sea animal with flippers, not a bird, no beak), with a wide whiskery grey muzzle, two long white tusks pointing down from his mouth, a bushy white mustache, small kind eyes behind round wire glasses, a tiny navy-blue captain's hat with a little gold anchor badge, a red-and-white stripy scarf, and a round, very red nose because he has a cold; he has flippers instead of hands and feet; he is the BIGGEST character: about three times Echo's height and taller than Pelly. MICE: three little grey clay mice with round pink ears, each about half Echo's height.

Echo stands on the lower porch step in the middle of the picture, laughing, wings up. The porch step is wide and runs from the middle to the right.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. GARDENER MOUSE: Gardener Mouse, ONE honey-brown clay mouse (brown, not grey) standing upright on two legs, with big round peach-pink ears, a pink nose, rosy cheeks, a long thin pink tail, a wide floppy straw sun hat with one white daisy tucked in its band, green overalls (dungarees) with one big front pocket over a cream shirt, and little brown boots; a little taller than Echo. DUCKS: two friendly clay ducks, always the same two: a mallard with a glossy green head, a thin white neck ring and a soft grey-brown body, and a speckled light-brown duck; both with orange bills and orange webbed feet; each about as tall as Echo. FROG: one little round leaf-green clay pond frog (a real frog, not a toy: no wind-up key) with a few darker green spots on its back, big golden eyes, a pale cream tummy and a wide happy smile; about half Echo's height. The place in this story is Gardener Mouse's garden on a sunny green hillside: sandy paths, low wooden beds of herbs, little seedlings, berry bushes and flowers, a white picket fence, a little stone spring near the top of the garden with a small wooden gate in front of it, a big chunky wooden waterwheel near the spring, a little wooden water tank on legs beside the wheel, open wooden water troughs (long wooden channels shaped like little slides, each with a U-shaped groove down its middle) and a small round stone-edged pond lower down the hill.

s01.picture: A bright sunny morning at the round blue front door of Echo's cottage (ECHO'S COTTAGE, exactly as in the attached earlier picture). Pelly the pelican stands on the left of the door and pulls one long lemon-yellow-and-lilac striped sock out of her beak pouch, the sock dangling from the tip of her bill, and blinks at it in surprise. Echo stands just right of the middle on the wide doorstep, laughing, one wing pointing at the sock.
s01.buddy: on the doorstep to the right of Echo, right of the door: plain step, nothing on it

s02.picture: Close up on the porch of Echo's cottage on a sunny morning. Pelly the pelican's big white wing (only her wing and the edge of her body, from the left edge) holds out a cream paper letter in the upper middle of the picture. On the letter is a child's crayon drawing of a little mouse in a straw hat beside a big wooden waterwheel, three droopy flowers and one big blue water drop: only crayon lines, no writing at all. Echo stands in front of a low wooden porch railing just left of the middle, leaning in toward the letter, eyes wide. The low wooden porch railing runs straight across the picture about two thirds of the way down.
s02.buddy: PEEK: the stretch of the railing's top edge just right of Echo, with nothing behind it but the background, so a little character can peek over the railing there

s03.picture: Just inside the little open wooden gate of the garden on a sunny green hillside. Sandy paths wind between low wooden beds where every flower and plant hangs its head, thirsty, with pale floppy leaves. Near the top of the picture, in the middle of its width, the big chunky wooden waterwheel stands still beside the little stone spring, with no wooden troughs joined to it. Right of the middle, a little lower, the small round stone-edged pond is completely empty: only dry pebbles at its bottom. Echo stands on the sandy path in the lower middle, just left of the middle, looking around with a worried, puzzled face, one wing on his cheek.
s03.buddy: on the sandy path just right of Echo: a patch of plain path, nothing on it

s04.picture: A close-up of the small round stone-edged pond in the garden, completely empty: dry pebbles and a few curled-up dry lily pads at its bottom. The two ducks sit side by side in the middle of the dry pond, each with a fluffy striped towel around its shoulders (one blue-and-white, one pink-and-white), looking around, puzzled and a little grumpy, as if asking where the water went. Droopy flowers lean over the pond's stone edge. Echo is not in this picture.

s05.picture: The middle of the garden in the sunshine. Gardener Mouse stands on the sandy path in the middle of the picture, beside a long low wooden flower bed of droopy daisies and tulips, and very carefully tips a teeny tiny tin watering can, no bigger than a thimble, over one droopy flower: one single drop of water falls from its spout. She is concentrating very hard, cheerful and determined, her straw hat tipped back. Echo stands on the path on the left of her and giggles behind one wing.
s05.buddy: on the sandy path just right of Gardener Mouse: plain path, nothing on it

s06.picture: Beside the big chunky wooden waterwheel, which stands still: a big messy heap of open wooden water troughs (long wooden channels shaped like little slides, each with a U-shaped groove) lies criss-crossed every which way on the sandy ground in the upper middle of the picture, with a scrubbing brush and a little bucket of soap bubbles beside it. Gardener Mouse stands on the right of the heap holding one trough, scratching her head under her straw hat with a sheepish smile. Echo stands in front of the heap, just left of the middle, looking up at it with his wings on his hips.
s06.buddy: on the sandy ground just right of Echo, in front of the heap: plain ground, nothing on it

s07.picture: A big sheet of cream paper pinned to the wooden wall of a little garden shed, filling the middle of the picture, with two simple crayon drawings stacked from top to bottom and no words at all. At the top: a little stone spring, a zigzag line of joined wooden troughs running from it to a big waterwheel, the wheel lifting blue water up, and more troughs carrying it down to a row of happy flowers and a round pond, with big curvy arrows showing the way the water goes. At the bottom, smaller: two wooden troughs that do not line up, with a gap between them and blue drops falling out of the gap, and a curved arrow beside one trough showing it should turn. No letters, no numbers. Nothing stands in front of the paper: no characters anywhere in the picture. Keep the paper in the top 85% of the picture. Echo is not in this picture.

s08.picture: At the little stone spring near the top of the garden on a sunny morning: clear water bubbles up in a stone basin behind a small closed wooden gate. Echo stands on a wide flat stone in front of the spring, in the middle of the picture, holding up one end of a wooden trough with both wings, ready and smiling. A little way off on the right stands the big chunky wooden waterwheel, still, and Gardener Mouse stands in front of it, holding her straw hat to her chest, hopeful and smiling. Below them the garden slopes gently down to the droopy flower beds.
s08.buddy: on the wide flat stone just left of Echo: plain stone, nothing on it

e01.picture: The hillside garden working at last, seen from a little way off: clear water runs from the little stone spring along a line of joined wooden troughs to the big chunky wooden waterwheel, which turns with water splashing off its paddles and lifts the water up into the little wooden water tank on legs beside it; from the tank, more joined troughs carry the water down to the low wooden beds of herbs, seedlings, berries and flowers, where every plant stands up tall and the flowers bloom pink, yellow and lilac, and into the small round stone-edged pond, now full and shining. Two little butterflies over the flowers. Echo is not in this picture, and no other character either.

e02.picture: The small round stone-edged pond, full of clear shining water with lily pads. The two ducks splash into it from its far edge in the upper middle, wings up, water flying, laughing, their striped towels dropped on the stones behind them. Blooming flowers all around the pond. Echo stands on the pond's flat stone edge in the lower left of the middle, laughing as a few drops splash him.
e02.buddy: on the pond's flat stone edge just right of Echo: plain flat stones, nothing on them

e03.picture: Beside the full pond, with the big wooden waterwheel turning in the background on the left: Gardener Mouse sits on a little wooden bench in the upper left of the middle, her boots up on a flowerpot, her teeny watering can hanging on a hook beside her, smiling. In the middle of the picture, on a big lily pad at the pond's edge, the little frog is snuggled inside one long lemon-yellow-and-lilac striped sock like a sleeping bag, only its head poking out, eyes half shut, smiling. Echo stands on the sandy path right of the lily pad, pointing at the frog and laughing.
e03.buddy: on the sandy path just right of Echo: plain path, nothing on it

e04.picture: Evening inside Echo's cozy round cottage, lamp-lit: a close-up of the helper map (THE HELPER MAP, the same map as in the attached earlier picture) pinned to the wall, filling the upper middle of the picture, with no writing anywhere on it. A soft white puffy cloud has just drifted off the map to one side, uncovering a new place: a little green garden on a hillside, with a tiny wooden waterwheel, little rows of flowers and a round blue pond. The gold stars already on the map stay exactly as in the attached picture. A low wooden bench stands under the map; Echo stands on the left half of the bench, on tiptoe, pressing ONE new shiny gold star sticker onto the little garden with one wing, beaming.
e04.buddy: the right half of the bench, just right of Echo: plain wooden bench top, nothing on it

stories.home: A wide picture for a game card. A sunny garden on a green hillside: in the middle stands a big chunky wooden waterwheel, stopped still, with no troughs joined to it, and a little stone spring bubbles at the back on the left. Echo stands left of the middle, holding up one open wooden water trough with both wings, looking hopeful, beside a messy heap of more wooden troughs on the sandy ground. Right of the middle, Gardener Mouse tips her teeny tiny watering can, no bigger than a thimble, over one droopy flower in a low wooden bed of thirsty, drooping flowers. Echo, the waterwheel, the troughs and Gardener Mouse are all in the middle band of the picture (their tops below 25% from the top and their bottoms above 75% from the top), Echo left of the middle and Gardener Mouse right of it. Only Echo and Gardener Mouse appear: no other characters.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. OTTER: Postmaster Otter, a sleek, friendly chocolate-brown clay otter with a cream face and chest, round whiskery cheeks, small round ears and a long, thick, round tail that tapers to a point (not flat, not a paddle), in a navy-blue peaked postmaster's cap with a little brass bell badge (no anchor) and a navy-blue jacket with two rows of shiny brass buttons; he stands upright on his back feet; about twice Echo's height. MOUSE: a small snow-white clay mouse (white all over: not grey, not brown, and only one of her) with big round pink ears, a pink nose, a long pink tail, a lilac dress with white dots and a tiny white apron; about as tall as Echo. HERON: a tall, thin, gentle grey-blue clay heron with long thin yellow legs, a long S-curved neck, a long pointed yellow bill, a little black feather crest at the back of his head and kind round eyes; no pouch; about two and a half times Echo's height. TURTLE: a small, young, bright-green clay turtle with a smooth, round, plain dark-green shell, big friendly eyes, chubby legs and a little orange knitted scarf; no glasses, no flowers (he is not Grandma Tortoise); about as tall as Echo. BEAVER: a chubby, cheerful honey-brown clay beaver with two big white front teeth, a round tummy, small round ears, a big flat dark-brown paddle tail with a criss-cross pattern and a little green-and-white checked neckerchief; about one and a half times Echo's height. THE POSTBOAT: the little postboat, a small turquoise wooden boat with a pointed front, a honey-wood inside with two little seats, a soft cream cloth canopy over its back half and a coil of rope at its back; no sail, no motor, no chimney, no name or writing on it; about four times Echo's length, just big enough for Echo and a few parcels.

s06.picture: Looking out across the sparkling turquoise bay on a sunny day at three little green islands. Far away in the upper left of the middle, on a small island, stands a little blue house: Mouse leans out of its round window, which has no curtains at all. In the upper right of the middle, on a second island beside a tall thatched cottage, Heron stands on one leg under one tiny grey rain cloud that rains only on him, dripping and blinking, while the sun shines everywhere else. Nearer, in the middle of the picture, on a third little island, Turtle sits in front of his low, mossy-roofed reading hut beside a small empty bookshelf, yawning, holding one old book upside down. Calm water fills the bottom of the picture. Echo is not in this picture. Gentle and funny, never sad.

Beaver stands on the raft beside the new door, holding up a small chewed-up scrap of wood with a round door knob still on it, with a sheepish, toothy grin, little wood chips around his feet. Echo stands on the floating jetty's planks in the lower left of the middle, laughing with both wings on his tummy. The floating jetty's plank deck runs across the lower third of the picture.

Just beyond it, in the middle of the picture, the little postboat (THE POSTBOAT) bobs on the water, tied to a jetty post, its pointed front to the left, nothing aboard yet. arcade: A wide picture for a button. Echo, cheerful and waving, in the very middle of the picture, with fun game things tumbling around him in the air: a juicy watermelon slice, an orange basketball, a black-and-white piano key, a soccer ball, and a cartoon dinosaur bone. A soft, bright sky-blue background with a few puffy clouds. Echo fills the middle third of the picture's width and the middle of its height; the game things stay around him. No text.
_chars: Each story's lineup is composed, not drawn: every character in `chars` is drawn alone on a transparent background, then gen-adventure.mjs stands them side by side on cream with ImageMagick, Echo first, each scaled to `h` (its height, Echo = 1). One character at a time keeps them from merging (the whole lineup in one picture gave Pelly the walrus's scarf, then lost her into him, 22 Oct 2026).
